[h1]Grindy, slow and repetitive[/h1] I like the game concept (having an autofire mode where you just choose the skills on each run), but the unlockables and upgrades are SO painfully slow to acquire, the game just becomes a repetition grind fest until you're powerful enough to beat its 3 areas' bosses. If that was the feeling from just the demo, the full game is a hard pass for me. Also, the art quality is... questionable. But that's very evident from the store page, so wasn't a surprise - just thought it was worth mentioning.

Legacy of Defense - Prologue is a really good game, even though it took me several hours just to get every achievement due to the RNG of skills. It's not entirely the games fault (though it doesn't help), I have terrible luck when it comes to video games. Every time. It's ridiculous, but again - me, not all on the game. Gameplay is quite simple and takes some time to get through, so except to restart A LOT. Choose a class and start up the game. As you work through mobs, you'll earn experience which you use to level up and unlock a skill to help you progress through the stages. Each boss you defeat earns you gold, which you use to upgrade two different types of trees (one is potions, one is skills/class bonuses). You'll eventually unlock every potion upgrade, plus every class/skill upgrade without really having to worry about money to afford them. The end of the game is basically farming over and over until you get the perfect combination of skills to get through the Cave (it's hard, y'all). I do recommend this if you enjoy playing action-idle-like games, but this is really not idle at all. You can tab out and it'll auto attack monsters and will pause itself when you level up and have to select a skill. It's very action-roguelike and I did enjoy the game for what it was.

It was fun for a while, but it got tedious super quick. Regular enemies die easily enough, but the bosses are super unbalanced. Some of them die super easily without you even noticing they showed up, and then others (mostly the stone golem) just takes 1 damage from everything except basic attacks. That one boss takes me as long to kill as the entirety of waves 1-19, even with the hunter with a lot of damage. Even with 4 levels into the one ability that gives stun resistance I spend more than half the fight stunned. It's gotten to the point where every run either beats the golem while exhausting half of all my potions, or its absurd amount of damage kills me before I can use the healing potions. Seriously, who decided it was a good idea to have one boss hit you a bunch of times in a row all within a second or two for massive damage each hit?

先说好的，这个游戏的确是我想找的那种解压的游戏，就选选升级项然后看角色在那爽杀就可以了，轻松休闲。 但是让人难受的点太多，最后还是卸载了。 1.游戏很卡，进游戏要卡，进升级选项退出来要卡，死掉结束一把的时候也要卡，刚开始看更新日志以为是游戏语言的问题，但换成其他语言也是一样要卡。 2.灾难的数值设计。 药水这东西当你要使用它的时候，大多数时候它也救不了你了。你的血量很少，我最多一把也才把血量涨到1000左右，如果想蹭50%血量以下的BUFF，那你的血量就更堪忧了。而怪物能够接近并攻击你，说明你的输出已经不足以清理怪物，怪物很快就把你淹了。这时候一瓶回25%HP的血药基本是无作用的，其他的无论是加防、加速、加攻击、加闪避的药水有点用但不多，因为它们那可怜的持续时间和可怜的数量都决定了你将在它们耗尽的时候暴毙。哦，对了，这药水除了初始带的之外唯一的获取途径就是点升级选项的生产药水，而且数量的上限只有几瓶。 完全无用的闪避属性，我最高的一把已经将仅有的三个提供闪避的升级选项点满两个，剩下的那个红色品质太稀有只点了一级，还不到50%闪避，其中一个为了提升闪避还得削HP上限，正如上面所说的，当怪能接近攻击你的时候说明你已经清不动怪了，这么点闪避能救你的命吗？答案是不能，你很快就会像条蛆那样死去了。自动防御的几率比闪避还要低，而且还不是免伤，根本没有点出来的价值。 变态的怪物数值成长，第一关正常，第二关初见端倪，防不了的毒和变态攻速的蘑菇怪就能稍微卡你几次，第三关的石头人初见秒杀看似恐怖但实际也只能秒700-800的血，你能保证血量或者护盾大于这个值并且能快速恢复就不成问题，最后就是不知道怎么过的第四关，到后面满屏幕四位数护盾的怪，而你的攻击力只有两位数，你升级选项的所有攻击项也都只能让你的攻击力膨胀200%以内，倒是有个技能写着20000%攻击力，但实际上没有，到了这关甚至连火焰药水都清不动怪，更别提混在中间的BOSS了。看了下成就，居然还有不少人能过？理解不了 3.稀少的升级选项，虽然玩到后面你上面会挂上一大堆图标，但无论你玩什么职业、玩多少次，上面挂着的也只会是这些图标。还有些纯搞笑的，CD长射不中怪的箭、只会劈身前的红色品质伤害超低的雷、被打二十来次丢一把的不痛不痒的斧，谁点谁傻。
